name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Gray.adjacent_one_bit
title: Consecutive reflected Gray codewords differ in exactly one bit
statement: For every natural number t, with gray(t) = t XOR floor(t/2), the XOR of gray(t) and gray(t+1) is a power of two. Used in the note pq-we-ggh15-chain-verdict: in a positional GGH15 witness-encryption hybrid over the reflected Gray order, consecutive thresholds change the comparator matrices of a single level.
